messages:
morgan: urgent exec ask from Axion 1: they want a concise go/no-go by COB. POC blocked by telemetry ingestion + clarity on sustained pricing. can we list owners and ETA for unblock?

sasha: i'll take pricing. need expected sustained rps and avg tokens/request to size options.

albert: they ran a sim: ~150 rps sustained, ~3.5k tokens avg, spikes to 380 rps for ~2 minutes. cc @sasha.

ria: telemetry is failing at our collector. seen 502 gateway + 415 Unsupported Media Type. sample curl from their side pasted: 

```
curl -X POST https://ingest.redwood.io/v1/events \\  
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  
  -d '{"events":[{"id":"abc","payload":"..."}]}'

# Response: 415 Unsupported Media Type
```

ria: looks like their client is sending Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-16. we can either ask them to change header or stand up S3/SQS ingest as temporary. S3/SQS path is quicker for the POC.

jenna: infra sizing note: for 150 rps @3.5k tokens suggests reserve of 5x A100 (mixed precision) or 8x T4 quantized. cost delta is ~2.1x for Dedicated vs hosted throttled bursts. i'll calc $ numbers and post two lines.

sasha: please provide two price lines: (1) Hosted tier with throttling & auto-fallback to lower-cost model (include estimated $/month + expected throttling behavior), (2) Dedicated reserved commit with canary rollback and cost per month + commit term. need both for exec.

morgan: security asks: they want telemetry retention and encryption details. did we share SOC2 docs?

albert: shared SOC2 package link earlier. retention for POC default 30d, extendable to 90d with DPA clause. all telemetry encrypted at rest with CMK if requested.

ria: to enable S3/SQS fallback run the commands below; I can do it if Axion provides bucket name + cross-account policy.

```
aws s3api create-bucket --bucket axion-poc-ingest-2026 --region us-west-2
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket axion-poc-ingest-2026 --policy file://axion-policy.json
aws sqs create-queue --queue-name axion-poc-ingest-queue
```

ria: estimate: ~2-3 hours to wire S3->SQS->ingest pipeline and validate.

infra-bot: Note: maintenance window scheduled tonight 00:30-01:00 UTC on ingest cluster. may affect validation.

morgan: owners/next steps: @ria = S3 fallback + validation (ETA 3h), @jenna = infra sizing + cost lines (ETA 90m), @sasha = assemble exec one-pager when numbers in (ETA 2h), @albert = security retention/KMS confirmation. i'll send the exec note once we have pricing and fallback confirmation. escalate to exec-bridge if we miss EOD. :thumbsup:

sasha: will draft the one-pager outline now1 will slot numbers when posted.

jenna: starting sizing calc now. ping me if Axion asks for a lower-cost quant profile trial.

morgan: thanks team. keep updates short. we only want 3 bullets for the exec update.
